name: 2 Thessalonians
author: The apostle Paul.
setting: Written to correct confusion about the day of the Lord.
theme: Stand firm and keep working while waiting for Christ.

outline.label: Justice at the revelation of Christ

christInBook: Christ will be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels (1:7), and the Lord Jesus will destroy the man of lawlessness by the breath of his mouth (2:8).
howToRead: This letter corrects a misunderstanding about the day of the Lord. Notice how Paul balances confidence in Christ’s return with the call to steady work.
